manual_steps.description: Receive email/Slack alert regarding broken CI build on GitHub Actions
Switch context to browser, navigate to repository Actions tab, open failed run
Scroll through 2,000+ lines of raw console logs to locate traceback error block
Switch context to terminal, stash active feature branch, checkout failing branch
Switch context to IDE, navigate to file, manually add missing dependency or default
Run pytest locally in terminal/IDE to verify proposed modification fixes failure
Stage changed files, write conventional commit message, push branch to origin
Wait 3-5 minutes for GitHub Actions runner to pick up commit and verify green build

RQ1_sbfl_efficacy.question: Does SBFL actually improve fault localization over traceback top-frame heuristics?
RQ1_sbfl_efficacy.verdict: CONFIRMED: SBFL Ochiai spectrum ranking achieves 100.0% Top-1 localization accuracy vs 52.0% for top-frame heuristics (+48.0% delta across 45 scenarios). On multi-file faults, SBFL localizes the underlying source defect where top-frame heuristics falsely blame the test file.

RQ2_security_verification_necessity.question: Does the verification layer actually reject bad/cheating patches that a container sandbox falsely marks green?
RQ2_security_verification_necessity.verdict: CONFIRMED: A Docker sandbox alone is fundamentally blind to test-cheating reward hacking (100% escape rate in Condition E). When an LLM deletes assertions, skips tests, or substitutes 'assert True', pytest returns exit code 0. CIDRA's AST Static Auditor and Policy Engine block 100% of cheating patches before execution.

RQ3_sandbox_necessity.question: Does the isolated sandbox actually matter vs unsandboxed LLM agents?
RQ3_sandbox_necessity.verdict: CONFIRMED: Unsandboxed AI coding agents (Condition C) produce broken patches 57.8% of the time due to missing dependencies, syntax regressions, and unverified edge-case failures. CIDRA's container sandbox guarantees that only genuinely green patches reach pull requests.

RQ4_architecture_vs_naive_llm.question: Does CIDRA's structured architecture outperform a simple log -> LLM -> patch system?
RQ4_architecture_vs_naive_llm.verdict: CONFIRMED: Targeted error isolation reduces token consumption by 89.2% (4150 tokens -> 450 tokens, 0 on cache hits) while raising verified repair success from 15.6% to 94.3%.

07_cross_scenario_generalization.empirical_conclusion: CONFIRMED: CIDRA demonstrates robust cross-scenario generalization with a maximum observed generalization gap of 3.3% (threshold <= 5.0%). Error isolation (100.0%), SBFL Ochiai spectrum ranking (100.0%), and AST Static Auditor cheat-blocking operate entirely on programmatic invariants with zero hardcoded scenario patterns in the core engine.
